whatThisIs: Every family holding a RASTER_PASS in data/rcap-grade-a/packet-factory-24h/RASTER_QUEUE.json immediately BEFORE lane INV01 taught generate-raster-queue.mjs to read a family declared complete outputs, measured at that queue rather than asserted. It is the cost ledger for that change: the change was required to cost none of them, and did not.
whatItIsNot: Not a record of packet correctness and not a promotion. A RASTER_PASS here means the visual gate rendered these exact bytes and found no defect it measures; it proves nothing else and opens no commercial route.
howToRefreshIt: Only when a packet is legitimately rebuilt. A rebuild changes the pinned bytes, and the test exempts a family whose canonical or boundary SHA-256 has moved, so a genuine rerender needs no edit here. A family whose bytes are unchanged and whose documentsDigest moved is a READER change, which is what this file exists to catch; refreshing the file to make that pass would erase the finding.
